हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A struggling delivery boy dies in an accident but wakes up inside a novel as its villain, forced to survive against the all-powerful hero. With wit, sarcasm, and unexpected charm, he twists fate while juggling danger, romance, and betrayal.
